title: a's, then b's, then c's: ε-closures do the work
notes: Two ε-moves chain three loops. The start set already holds all three states, and every later set is closed under ε-moves too. Missing moves lead to the dead state.
ops: start q0; accept q2; q0 a -> q0; q0 eps -> q1; q1 b -> q1; q1 eps -> q2; q2 c -> q2
